## Multi-character conversation

Nodes: [Enemyx-net/VibeVoice-ComfyUI](https://github.com/Enemyx-net/VibeVoice-ComfyUI) created by Fabio Sarracino. Model: Microsoft VibeVoice — [1.5B](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/VibeVoice-1.5B) or the [Large](https://huggingface.co/aoi-ot/VibeVoice-Large) re-host.

## Models

```dotenv
COMFY_ASSET_PROFILES=vibevoice-large
```

or `vibevoice-1.5b` for the small one. Both ungated.

```
📂 ComfyUI/models/vibevoice/
├── 📂 tokenizer/            ← Qwen2.5-1.5B tokenizer, four small files
├── 📂 VibeVoice-1.5B/       ← 5.0 GB
└── 📂 VibeVoice-Large/      ← 17.4 GB
```

The model dropdown is built from whatever folders exist, so it is empty until the profile has finished downloading — refresh the browser afterwards.
nodes.title: Credit and models

widgets_values:
## Writing the script

Label every line `[1]:` … `[4]:`. The number of speakers is detected from the text, so you do not declare it anywhere. Up to four.

`[pause]` inserts a beat, `[pause:800]` inserts 800 ms. Both are wrapper features, not model tokens.

## Giving each character a voice

The four **Load Audio** nodes are muted. Unmute one and pick a clip to clone that speaker's voice; leave a speaker muted and the model invents a voice for them. Ten to thirty seconds of clean speech is plenty — more does not help.

No sample to hand and you want a *specific* voice? Use **Text to Speech (Prompted Voices to Conversation)** instead: it describes the voice in words and hands the result to this same node.

## Settings that matter

- `model`: Large is markedly better at holding four voices apart; 1.5B is fine for one or two and a third of the size.
- `cfg_scale` 1.3 is the official default. Above ~1.6 it starts over-articulating.
- `use_sampling` off is deterministic and the recommended production setting; turn it on with `temperature` / `top_p` when you want takes to differ.
- `quantize_llm` 4bit halves memory at a small quality cost — unnecessary on a Spark.
- `diffusion_steps` 20 is the sweet spot; past ~40 there is little left to gain.
- `attention_type` auto picks sage or sdpa. Pin it to `sdpa` if you hit anything odd.
- `voice_speed_factor` re-times the *reference* clip, which drags the generated delivery with it. 0.95 for a slower read.

`diffusion_steps` is set to 40 rather than the wrapper's default 20: the extra passes are cheap next to the LLM stage and the diction is cleaner. Drop it back toward 20 if you are iterating on a script.
